{{Top|leg}}
The story of '''FK-4''' was a legend about a bodiless [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that passed its consciousness between droids through a communication interface or even touch. When possessed by FK-4, a droid would violate its programming and lie, cheat or steal to accomplish its goal. It could only utter the word "[[Valanka]]."
